items.quote: I'm willing to do whatever it takes for as long as it takes.
items.statement: Real estate success requires a mindset willing to endure long periods of effort without immediate results.

items.quote: It's at least six months of going through the pain.
items.statement: The real estate process typically involves at least six months of effort before seeing results.

items.quote: learning, pushing, creating relationship with the client.
items.statement: Building a relationship with clients is essential during the initial phase of real estate sales.

items.quote: the pendulum gonna swing and then you will have results.
items.statement: Results in real estate tend to come after prolonged effort, with potential variability in timing.

overview: Transcript of a YouTube short discussing the mindset required for success in real estate.
